Volunteer Troy Wouters plants a bitterbrush seedling on the Willow Fire area Saturday, April 6, 2013 as part of a volunteer sagebrush seedling rehabilitation effort. Almost 40 volunteers showed up rep
This shrub is most common at the upper elevations of the sagebrush steppe in this area.
Bitterbrush is common in the sagebrush steppe most in the upper elevation above the floor of the Snake River plains (e.g., above 5500 feet).
